<page>
Watson & Hines LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 832-555-6543
Letter of Representation
8 Oct 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1449
Our client: Jose Mercado
Date of loss: 23 Sep 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the low-speed head-on
collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for
statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office and do not contact our client
directly.
We ask that you provide the full policy limits for each policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, including any excess
or umbrella coverage, along with a written confirmation of those limits within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.
We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle and
telematics data, photographs, repair and salvage records, claim notes, adjuster reports, recorded statements, and
any communications with the other driver or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these
materials until the claim is fully resolved.
Our client's injuries and treatment will be documented separately, and we will forward those records once they are
available. Thank you for your prompt attention to these requests.
Sincerely,
Susan Johnson
Watson & Hines LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
